## What's new

### Remote server: Codex and phone status fixes
Fixes found in real use of the phone remote.

- **Codex conversations are back**: Codex 0.160 and later changed how its
  session files are marked, so ymux no longer recognised them and the phone
  showed the screen instead of the conversation. Codex panes show as a
  conversation again. The same fix brings back Codex session resume after a
  restart and Codex entries in the activity log.
- **"Needs an answer" badge**: the phone's list no longer keeps the badge after
  the question was answered. A Codex or Gemini approval prompt now shows as
  "needs an answer".
- **"x minutes ago"**: the time on the phone's list now counts from when the
  shown status began.
- **Window minimised or hidden**: the phone stays up to date while the ymux
  window is minimised or hidden to the tray.
- **Codex context**: Codex's own injected context (hooks, skills, browser and
  IDE context) is no longer shown as your message.
- **Two Codex sessions in one folder**: when two interactive Codex sessions run
  in the same folder, ymux shows the screen for that pane instead of guessing
  which conversation belongs to it. The same goes for a pane after `/new` or
  `/fork` in Codex.

### Upgrade notes
- Nothing changes unless the remote server is switched on.
- No server update needed: yMux-Server 0.19.0 stays.
- No new keyboard shortcuts.
